data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure step by step (Gutenberg search, then author and downloads, then IMDb search, then film year and rating, then a 'Unit:' note in the exact format) with the right single parameter, but it leaves out a few details an automation would need: picking the *first* film adaptation, clicking "New note", and pressing Enter.
